audit: Word-Final /t,d/ Cluster Reduction Before to — ASR Collision Audit Addendum

candidate_generation.existing_candidate_rule: Filter immutable closed-audit candidates to target word-final consonant cluster ending /t/ or /d/, following token to with initial /t/, and exact one-final-phone deletion. No candidate generation rerun for other environments.
candidate_generation.paraphrase_rule: Enumerate only accepted paraphrase surfaces with a word immediately before token to; use the pinned CMUdict pronunciations and require a word-final coda cluster whose last segment is /t/ or /d/.
candidate_generation.new_candidate_rule: Delete only that final /t/ or /d/ segment, preserve all other phones exactly, and match against a different-spelling CMUdict word present in the pinned 20k frequency list. Rank/manual major-word screening is applied at adjudication.
candidate_generation.morphology: Spelling or morphology differences alone do not cause REJECT if the phonetic conditions hold.
candidate_generation.duplicate_key: surface_ref + target_word_index + deleted final phone + collision word

adjudication.family: word-final consonant cluster + final /t/ or /d/ + immediately following token to /t/
adjudication.authority: productive connected-speech cluster reduction or strong masking; individual dictionary weak-form evidence is not required
safe_invariants: word onset and all remaining phones identical
no insertion, deletion, substitution, or generic fuzzy match
adjudication.review_policy: REVIEW is reserved for pronunciation authority ambiguity, homograph ambiguity, non-exact deletion, unsupported phrase boundary, or generation defect; none remained.
